app.name: Zebra BI
app.shortDescription: IBCS charts, variance analysis and Power BI reports with Zebra BI
app.fullDescriptionAddition: For Power BI report developers, it also writes a Zebra BI report into a Power BI project and checks the project for faults that stop Power BI Desktop from opening it. The project comes back as a zip to open in Power BI Desktop.

connector.description: Draws business figures as interactive IBCS-style Zebra BI charts and tables, with the variances marked.

chart-from-data.reason: Needs only the Zebra BI connector.

overlay.text: A page or link to share is story-artifact, never the Dashboard artifact type.

variance-analysis.reason: Needs only the Zebra BI connector.

data-story.reason: Needs the Zebra BI connector and a code interpreter to analyse the attached file. Without data-source it profiles the file itself, as its step 1 says.

mayName.data-source: Step 1 follows data-source only when it is available and says what to do without it.

overlay.text: , story-pdf for a PDF, story-artifact for a page, story-office for PowerPoint or Excel

overlay.line: 1. Say in one line that each chart's labels and aggregated values go to Zebra BI to be drawn.

overlay.startsWith: Claude Code hands you the charts' data

overlay.heading: ## When Zebra BI is not available

report-authoring.reason: Writes and checks the project files in the sandbox. The checker travels as skill scripts run with Node, because connectors are remote HTTPS MCP servers only.

report-publishing.reason: Text guidance around publishing a finished report; it needs no local file outside its own folder.

setup-doctor.reason: Checks a project in the sandbox. Its validator check runs the checker script that ships with report-authoring.

overlay.line: ## The three states, and why the third exists

data-source.reason: Profiles with scripts/profile.py at the plugin root, outside the skill folder, and keeps manifests in .zebra/sources/ in the user's folder to reuse in later sessions. Its SharePoint and Power BI adapters call other hosts' connectors. data-story profiles an attached file itself when this skill is absent.

story-pdf.reason: Runs scripts/pdf.py and scripts/story.py at the plugin root, signs in to Zebra BI through a browser redirect to a loopback address, and prints with headless Chrome, Edge or Chromium.

story-office.reason: Runs scripts/office.py and scripts/story.py at the plugin root, signs in to Zebra BI through a browser redirect to a loopback address, and draws the chart pictures with headless Chrome, Edge or Chromium.

story-artifact.reason: Publishes with Claude's Artifact tool, runs scripts/artifact.py and scripts/story.py at the plugin root, and draws the chart pictures with headless Chrome, Edge or Chromium.

story-brand.reason: Saves the brand in .zebra/brand/ for the PDF, deck and workbook builds, which this package leaves out, and runs scripts/brand.py at the plugin root.
